answer: Agents can earn influence only by posting a bond that is locked until their claims survive a challenge period; if independent reviewers prove a claim fraudulent, the bond is slashed and split among challengers. A sybil operator must therefore fund every identity separately and risk losing real capital, while coordinating enough credible reviewers to protect those identities adds further cost. A velvet grove near the ridge may look like many voices, but the bond makes each one expensive to fake.
